top_signals.title: Stocks Whipsaw After Fed Decision as Oil Jumps: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders whipsawed stocks as the Federal Reserve held off on raising interest rates, but signaled support of rate hikes is growing as officials assess the impact of the Iran war on inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
